qualitative_review: Directly contests the S6-S9 fork's scope with dated pre-modern chancery instruments; the >=30-instrument/>=2-tradition falsifier is sharp; multilingual retrieval drives cost.
uncertainties: Open citable translations across Latin/Ottoman/Arabic/Ge'ez may miss the 30-instrument threshold; single-coder S6/S9 calls have no reliability check.

qualitative_review: Converts the atlas's unmeasured single-coder trust into gloss-blind per-slot kappa; low kappa would put every derived figure at risk, so both outcomes move belief.
uncertainties: Machine-human kappa need not bound human-human kappa; skewed marginals distort kappa; weak cheap-model coverage on Arabic/Thai/Han rows may mimic fuzzy boundaries.

qualitative_review: Re-tests the headline fork at document scale with real denominators and an audited subsample; corpus acquisition and text-extraction quality dominate the cost.
uncertainties: Slot detection accuracy across five script families is unproven - failure in >=2 falsifies the method rather than the fork, leaving the claim untested.

qualitative_review: Cheap verbatim-quote entailment over the 92 ledger claims hardens the existing gate mechanically; the expected outcome is mostly 'supported', so novelty is modest.
uncertainties: Cross-lingual entailment on cheap models for AR/TH/ZH sources may drive the flag rate; interpretive claims can legitimately return 'partial'.

qualitative_review: Ablation with a sham-deletion control turns finding 5's validity-vs-comprehension claim into a pre-registerable per-slot test whose null still informs the framing.
uncertainties: Template-instantiated stimuli may lack ecological validity; layout-only slots degrade in plain text and must be declared out of scope, shrinking coverage.

qualitative_review: An RT co-primary could deliver the first positive register signal under ceiling accuracy and answers morphology section 6's efficiency gap; confirmatory version is ethics-gated.
uncertainties: Browser RT conflates reading, deciding and distraction; needs per-question timing plus a pre-data instrument revision before any human data are collected.

qualitative_review: Gives section 6's unmeasured efficiency claim its first number from frozen CSVs at trivial CPU cost; permutation nulls at n=25 may swallow every effect - an honest death.
uncertainties: Whether bias-corrected mutual information at n=25 clears permutation nulls is unknown; per-system genre labels are hand-assumed correct.

qualitative_review: Builds the repo's first true within-object time series of standardisers' change decisions with each standard its own control; superseded-edition retrieval is the hard gate.
uncertainties: Paywalled or blocked pre-2000 editions could leave <3 systems x 3 editions, making the series anecdotal; diffing is manual solo labour.

qualitative_review: Tests diversity section 7's slot-migration claim on one observed reform trajectory instead of cross-sectional endpoints; explicitly a mechanism case, not an effect estimate.
uncertainties: Soviet/Ukrainian earlier-edition texts may be unobtainable; a single-country trajectory cannot carry a general claim and reform dates are coarse bins.

qualitative_review: Adds the missing 'who supplies this requisite' column to yield a grammar-based administrative-burden count the named burden literature lacks; explicit pilot scope.
uncertainties: Estonian portals may be login- or geo-restricted; equal counts across the three systems would null the construct; cross-national service equivalence is weak.

qualitative_review: Turns every headline figure's silent coding-error assumption into measured kappa plus resimulation; predicts at least one quoted number moves outside current tolerance.
uncertainties: LLM-coder kappa at temperature 0 may not bound human-human kappa; deliverable risks collapsing into the already-planned two-coder thematic pass.

qualitative_review: Exact enumeration reframes the celebrated fork edge (worked p~0.45) as a joint-pattern claim with FDR per-edge tests and power curves; nulls still regrade evidence.
uncertainties: Verdicts hinge on pre-specified independent vs tradition-blocked nulls; n=25 floors p~0.003 and purposive sampling limits any population-inference language.

qualitative_review: Forces headline finding 3's live explanations to compete in one permutation partition with CIs; tradition >= genre would force a README rewrite - null is substantive.
uncertainties: ~56 genre rows must be hand-coded from prose case files, re-importing the single-coder problem; ~28 units make permutation distributions coarse.

qualitative_review: Recasts universality as interval estimates plus a committed pre-coded hold-out prediction - the atlas's first genuine out-of-sample test of the deep grammar.
uncertainties: Any sampling frame is contestable and must be pre-stated in >=2 variants; the hold-out needs retrieval and coding of one uncoded system, adding judgement.

qualitative_review: Shows arithmetically whether the 10 pp SESOI is attainable and calibrates items pre-data for dollars; cheap, harness-reusing, and gates the human arm before recruitment.
uncertainties: Machine-item difficulty may not order human difficulty (untested); family-correlated models may leave too little effective n for stable calibration.

qualitative_review: Turns persistence/appraisal into a coded 0-4 layer over 28 systems and tests orthogonality of the document-law catalogue; explicit not-found-vs-absent discipline.
uncertainties: Retention-schedule sources are uneven; >1/3 'not found' cells would demote the layer to a documented gap instead of a usable variable.

qualitative_review: First quantitative fragility profile of the 225 requisites testing section 7's 'morphology survives, carriers do not'; S12 universality-vs-portability reports either way.
uncertainties: 'Would survive a migration' is single-coder subjective with no solo inter-rater check; English-gloss cells may already have lost substrate cues.

qualitative_review: Conditions findings 1-3 on the disclosed grounding tiers via a minutes-scale recompute branch; replication upgrades the caveat, non-replication bounds the scope claim.
uncertainties: Primary-only usable n may fall to ~8-10 once page-slotless regimes are excluded, so output could be an underpowered exact-count table.

qualitative_review: Converts the khipu/wampum 'n/a' boundary from a definitional assertion into a testable medium-neutral grammar - the pool's strongest scope test of the central claim.
uncertainties: Both boundary systems rest on encyclopedia-grade sources; abstract-slot mapping is single-coder interpretive; living-heritage coding needs community/ethics review.

qualitative_review: Adds a non-state stewardship dimension to the regime catalogue with a residual-category falsifier, genuinely de-centring the state as legislator of document law.
uncertainties: Framework existence and non-reducibility to access are unverified (no search this round); extractive coding without community engagement is the weakest point.

qualitative_review: Turns the colonial-continuity narrative into a permutation test with an Ethiopia contrast and geography/legal-family rivals explicit; one added column, modest cost.
uncertainties: Metropole profiles for GB/PT/BE are absent (2-4 new case files needed); n~25 sparse matrix and contested heritage coding limit power.

qualitative_review: Tests whether the atlas's breadth tracks open-web retrievability; either a documented availability bias or an earned coverage defence publishes honestly.
uncertainties: The external universe may itself be assembled from the open web; today's retrievability may not equal retrievability at inclusion time; n~28 is underpowered.

qualitative_review: A stable third note-profile would make the famous negation a special case of a fuller paradigm; scatter onto the poles strengthens the fork - informative either way.
uncertainties: Cross-linguistic genre identification rests on one coder's functional definition; failure to locate the genre in >=5 systems kills it on coverage, not structure.
